narrative.intro: Ameresco recorded $57.7M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Ameresco won 7 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $8.2M, and obligations fell 81.4% year over year. Ameresco received substantially less in FY2027 to date than in FY26, when obligations were $309M, and far less than FY25, when obligations were $541M. Ameresco has a multi-year history of federal work, with obligations of $122M in FY22, $107M in FY23, and $75.8M in FY24. Ameresco concentrated most FY2027 to date buying with the Department of Veterans Affairs, which accounted for $56.4M of obligations. Ameresco also had smaller FY2027 obligations from the Department of Justice, at $1.3M, and the Department of the Interior, at $33.4K. Ameresco showed no FY2027 obligations from the General Services Administration or the National Archives and Records Administration.

sections.heading: Who are Ameresco's main federal customers?

The General Services Administration and the National Archives and Records Administration recorded $0 in FY2027 obligations to Ameresco.

Ameresco sells to several federal agencies, led by the Department of Veterans Affairs, which obligated $56.4M in FY2027 to date.
